project_structure: Full-stack app: React SPA frontend (Vite + TypeScript + React Router) with FastAPI/SQLAlchemy backend. Frontend uses a custom in-memory chapterStore (pub-sub pattern with useSyncExternalStore) for chapter data caching, and useProjectData hooks for per-page data loading. Pages are loaded as persistent outlets (kept alive) and detect cross-page data changes via localStorage timestamps (wizard.ts markWizardProjectChanged / getWizardProjectChangedAt). The outline page has DetailedOutlineSection with chapter skeleton generation (streaming SSE). The writing page loads chapter data from chapterStore which has stale-check logic.

relevant_files.rationale: Contains generateChapterSkeleton() at L265-L326 which is the streaming chapter skeleton generation function. After SSE completes, it refreshes the detailed outline list and selected item, but does NOT call chapterStore.invalidateProjectChapters() or markWizardProjectChanged(). This is the primary bug location.

key_code.description: SSE streaming chapter skeleton generation. After backend creates chapters via _create_chapter_records(), this function calls refresh() and getDetailedOutline() but NEVER calls chapterStore.invalidateProjectChapters(). This is the root cause of stale writing page data.

Non-streaming chapter creation path. The previous fix (commit bc36a2a) correctly added chapterStore.invalidateProjectChapters() here at L389 and L406, but the streaming path (generateChapterSkeleton) was missed.

patterns: Cache invalidation pattern: (1) chapterStore.invalidateProjectChapters(projectId) marks meta stale=true, triggers subscribeMeta listeners re-rendering useChapterMetaList; (2) markWizardProjectChanged(projectId) writes localStorage timestamp + dispatches DOM event, detected by writing page useEffect on activation. Both should fire after chapter-creating ops. createChapters follows pattern (commit bc36a2a). useOutlineSwitcher follows at L55-L58. generateChapterSkeleton is the only chapter-creating path missing both signals.
